lines.text: Many learners say: My father is engineer.
Better: My father is an engineer.
A job word needs a or an.
A nurse! She is a nurse.

data.why: A job word needs a or an.

native.hook: 说职业，前面别漏掉 a/an！
native.tip: 中文“他是工程师”不用冠词，英语里说职业，前面要加 a 或 an。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “My father is engineer.”😅 中文说“我爸爸是工程师”，职业前面什么都不用加；英语却要有 a/an：“My father is an engineer.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.hook: A job needs a or an!
en.tip: In English, a job word needs a or an before it.
en.caption: Do you say “My father is engineer.” 😅 In English, a job word needs a or an: “My father is an engineer.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
